items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: he’s really a great player, a piano player, his name escapes me. MR. Kirkland? Kenny Kirkland? No. He plays with the famous trio.

ctx.x: With Kenny Garrett. When Kenny Garrett was playing with him and the cat now, he’s really a great player, a piano player, his name escapes me. MR. Kirkland? Kenny Kirkland?
No. He plays with the famous trio. They’ve been together forever. They play nothing but standards, they never rehearsed. They played great.
